question: Should ClawSweeper accept this default-off GitNexus-backed deep-regression review contract and required decision-schema surface after the timestamp regression is fixed?
rationale: The branch changes prompt context, redaction behavior, durable schema, cache state, and marker gates, so code review can identify defects but cannot set the permanent product and security boundary alone.

options.title: Accept after targeted fix
options.body: Fix the timestamp regression, then merge the default-off lane with the documented advisory GitNexus boundary and continue tuning from real review runs.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Keep deterministic high-risk classification while deferring GitNexus prompt insertion or required schema durability to a smaller follow-up.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Hold or close the PR if graph-backed deep-regression review should not be part of ClawSweeper core yet.

recommendation.title: Accept after targeted fix
recommendation.body: Fix the timestamp regression, then merge the default-off lane with the documented advisory GitNexus boundary and continue tuning from real review runs.
